additional_info.subject: 0396986 - ID0396986-DC/Si-D/QA-[L1sCCz] Remove Image CRM:00472000252
additional_info.body:
Hello Sadek,
You don't need to remove this version from the rollout. If you want to install v6.0.3, install first this v5.0.19 and then update to v6.0.3.
You don't need to install v5.0.23 on the process. Steps are v4.0.11 → v5.0.X → v6.0.3.
If you agree I will close this ticket.
With best regards,
Joao Francisco Louro Cardoso

additional_info.subject: RE: 0396986 - ID0396986-DC/Si-D/QA-[L1sCCz] Remove Image CRM:00472000252
additional_info.body:
Hi Sadek,
As recommended by the PLM, in the release notes, the charger running on 4.0.11 of needs to be updated to 6.0.3, it can be updated to 5.X.
This doesn’t mean that the charger must be on 5.0.23.
Any FW upgrade goes thru the major update process, like
2.X -> 3.x -> 4.x -> 5.x -> 6.X
Where X can be any minor version. Hence updating from 5.0.19 to 6.0.23 should not be a concern.
Best Regards,
Reetesh Sharma
